title: kotoba-os OCI Artifact (content-addressed, IPFS-pulled)
description: ADR-2606031600 §D4. A kotoba-os unikernel image packaged as an OCI artifact whose reference IS its kotoba CID, pulled from IPFS — NOT from a commercial container registry. The OCI manifest's sha2-256 digest and the CIDv1(raw, sha2-256) are the SAME hash re-encoded: cid = multibase-base32(0x01 0x55 0x12 0x20 || digest). This keeps the k8s edge inside the blockchain-self-contained / IPFS substrate and the donation-funded mesh (no Docker Hub / GHCR). Scheduled by the Murakumo kubelet (ADR-2605214000).

imageRef.description: Content-addressed reference. MUST be ipfs:// + the CIDv1 — never a registry/tag (no Docker Hub / GHCR / Quay).

digest.description: The OCI manifest digest (sha2-256). Equals the multihash inside `cid`.

cid.description: CIDv1(raw codec 0x55, sha2-256) over the same digest. bafkrei… prefix.

runtimeClass.description: How k8s runs the unikernel image. microVM (Firecracker/uhyve/Kata) or a WASM containerd shim.

gateways.description: IPFS gateways / Bitswap peers to fetch the CAR from; any will do (content re-verified against the CID).

genesisManifestCid.description: CID of the genesis manifest this image boots (links to the D1 boot contract).
